name: Heathen
overview: Scripture reveals that heathen nations were often cast out of the land of Canaan due to their defiling wicked practices, as God warns in Leviticus that these nations defiled the land and were judged accordingly. Their territories were given to Israel, marking a divine judgment and inheritance transition. Despite their general exclusion from the temple and covenant blessings, God revealed Himself to certain heathen individuals such as Melchizedek, a priest of the Most High God, and gave divine messages to rulers like Abimelech and Cyrus, demonstrating His sovereign engagement beyond Israel. Notably, figures like Pharaoh and the Magi also received divine revelations, underscoring God's providence and purpose even among the nations outside Israel.
